name: Inbox
desc: Email marketing and transactional email automation with INBOX (useinbox.com). Manage contacts, lists, campaigns, and react to delivery events.

actions.name: add_contact_to_list
actions.description: Adds a single contact to an INBOX contact list. Creates the contact if the email is new, otherwise updates the existing contact and ensures it is part of the list.

actions.name: create_contact_list
actions.description: Creates a new contact list in INBOX where you can later add contacts.

actions.name: update_contact
actions.description: Updates an existing INBOX contact. You can add or replace tags and set custom field values.

actions.name: unsubscribe_contact
actions.description: Changes a contact status to Unsubscribed so they stop receiving campaigns from INBOX. You can also mark them as Hard Bounce or Spam Reported.

actions.name: create_campaign
actions.description: Schedules an INBOX campaign that sends a saved newsletter to one or more contact lists.

actions.name: send_transactional_email
actions.description: Sends a one-off transactional email through INBOX Notify (e.g. password reset, receipt, welcome).

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a new contact is added to your INBOX account (through a form, manual entry, import, or API).

triggers.name: new_campaign
triggers.description: Triggers when a new campaign is created in your INBOX account.

triggers.name: email_bounced
triggers.description: Triggers when a transactional email permanently bounces (hard bounce) — the recipient address does not exist or is blocked.

triggers.name: email_spam_reported
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient marks a transactional email as spam in their inbox.

triggers.name: email_opened
triggers.description: Triggers each time a transactional email is opened by the recipient. Fires on every open (not unique).

triggers.name: email_clicked
triggers.description: Triggers when a recipient clicks a tracked link inside a transactional email.
